summary.text: Michele Poague is the Libertarian candidate for Colorado State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has been a Libertarian candidate in several earlier Colorado elections, including for State Senate District 29 in 2012, 2016 and 2020 and for lieutenant governor in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Michele Poague ran unopposed in the Libertarian primary for Colorado State Senate District 29 in 2012 and lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Morgan Carroll.
She was a candidate for the same seat in 2016, when Rhonda Fields won, and again in 2020, when she received 31.3 percent of the vote against incumbent Fields.
In 2022 she was the Libertarian candidate for lieutenant governor of Colorado and received 1.2 percent of the vote.
